headline.en: UNI reclaims the $5.96 DAO burn anchor on a +5% bounce, but net emission still runs +1.68%/yr — v4 fee vote is the only catalyst that matters.
headline.zh: UNI 反弹 5% 重新站上 $5.96 的 DAO 销毁成本锚,但净通胀仍有 +1.68%/年 —— v4 protocol fee 投票才是真正的催化剂。

keyChanges.en: Price $6.68 sits ~12% above the $5.96 treasury burn implied price, the DAO's own fair-value mark; +5.18% 24h reverses part of the -3.59% weekly drawdown.
keyChanges.zh: 现价 $6.68 高于 DAO 国库销毁隐含成本 $5.96 约 12%,即协议自身认定的公允价值;24h +5.18% 部分修复了周内 -3.59% 的回撤。

keyChanges.en: Annualized revenue $198.09M → $33.68M buyback vs 20M UNI fixed emission = 14.96M UNI net emission/yr (+1.68%). The burn narrative still does not offset dilution at this price.
keyChanges.zh: 年化协议收入 $198.09M,对应 buyback(回购)预算 $33.68M,而年发行 20M UNI,净发行仍为 14.96M/年(+1.68%)。当前价位下 burn(销毁)叙事仍无法抵消稀释。

keyChanges.en: Two live temp checks — Activate v4 Protocol Fees and Robinhood Chain fee expansion — are the first governance items in months that directly attack the revenue side of the net-inflation equation.
keyChanges.zh: 两项 temp check 同时进行 —— 激活 v4 协议费与 Robinhood Chain 费用扩展 —— 是数月来首批直接作用于净通胀公式收入端的治理议案。

contrarianObservation.en: If the v4 Protocol Fees temp check advances to onchain vote and passes, buyback capacity could scale 30-50% off the same TVL, flipping UNI net-deflationary within a quarter. At $6.68 you are getting that optionality below the DAO's own $5.96 mark plus a 12% premium — cheap for a binary that governance is quietly queuing.
contrarianObservation.zh: 若 v4 协议费 temp check 推进至链上投票并通过,在 TVL 不变的情况下 buyback 规模可扩大 30-50%,一个季度内即可让 UNI 转为净通缩。$6.68 相当于以 DAO 自认公允价 $5.96 上浮 12% 的价格,买入一个治理正在悄悄铺路的二元期权 —— 并不贵。

watchNext.en: Outcome and vote weight distribution on the [Temp Check] Activate v4 Protocol Fees thread — this is the single biggest revenue lever on the table.
watchNext.zh: 关注 [Temp Check] Activate v4 Protocol Fees 的投票结果与票权分布 —— 这是当前收入端最重要的杠杆。

watchNext.en: Any resurfacing of the real-yield RFC (buybacks → stakers). It is conspicuously absent from today's top 5 threads; silence here is itself a signal.
watchNext.zh: 关注 real-yield RFC(将 buyback 分配给 stakers)是否重回讨论。今日 top 5 帖子中缺席,沉默本身即是信号。

watchNext.en: Weekly close vs $5.96. Losing that level re-opens the $4-5 institutional accumulation zone and invalidates the bounce.
watchNext.zh: 周线是否守住 $5.96。跌破将重新打开 $4-5 的机构建仓区间,本次反弹随之失效。

fullReasoning.en: Today's +5.18% print is noise inside a still-broken structure. The only number that matters is the net-inflation ratio: at $198M annualized revenue and 17% buyback allocation, UNI burns roughly 5M tokens versus 20M emitted — the protocol is diluting holders by 1.68% per year even after Fee Switch. That is why price has not been able to sustain a proper trend above the $5.96 treasury anchor despite the burn narrative being live for over a year. Derivatives confirm the lack of conviction: $40.6M OI is thin, funding is essentially flat at +0.01%, and a 1.5 long/short ratio is retail-tilted but not extreme — no positioning to squeeze. The interesting development is governance, not price. Two temp checks — v4 Protocol Fees and Robinhood Chain expansion — target the revenue side directly. Meanwhile the real-yield RFC, the single most important variable in the framework, is absent from today's top threads. That silence keeps me neutral rather than constructive. Stance: hold, don't chase. Buyers below $5.96 have edge; buyers at $6.68 are paying for optionality that governance has not yet delivered. Wait for the v4 fee vote to resolve before sizing up.
fullReasoning.zh: 今日 +5.18% 只是破损结构中的噪音。唯一重要的数字是净通胀比率:年化收入 $198M、17% 用于 buyback,年销毁约 5M UNI,对应 20M 发行 —— 即便 Fee Switch 已上线,持有人仍以 1.68%/年被稀释。这正是 burn 叙事运行一年多以来,价格始终无法在 $5.96 国库锚之上走出趋势的原因。衍生品端印证信心不足:OI $40.6M 偏薄,funding 几乎持平于 +0.01%,long/short 比 1.5 虽偏多但不极端,无可挤仓的头寸。真正值得关注的变化在治理端,而非价格。两项 temp check —— v4 Protocol Fees 与 Robinhood Chain 费用扩展 —— 直接指向收入端。而框架中最关键的变量 real-yield RFC 今日在热门帖中缺席,这份沉默让我维持中性而非转多。策略:持有,不追。$5.96 下方的买家有优势;$6.68 追多相当于为治理尚未兑现的期权付费。等 v4 费用投票落地再考虑加仓。
